# CookieGuard

> Evidence-based audits of authentication-cookie configuration (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite, Domain scope, lifetime, __Host-/__Secure- prefixes) for web applications you own or are authorized to test. Results are PASS, FAIL, or INCOMPLETE with exit codes 0/1/2, rule IDs CG001-CG009, and fixes. Cookie values are never output. Runs locally; no telemetry.

Use it to add a session-cookie check to a Browser Use agent login, a Playwright end-to-end test, a CI job, or an MCP client. It audits configuration only: it does not test XSS, CSRF, exploitability, or server-side session handling.

## Integrations

- [Browser Use (PyPI: cookieguard-browser-use 0.1.0)](https://github.com/aiscihub/cookieguard-ai/tree/main/integrations/browser-use): `pip install cookieguard-browser-use`; `CookieGuardAudit` observes the agent's browser over its own CDP connection and enforces the result outside the agent.
- [Playwright (npm: @aiscihub/cookieguard-playwright 0.2.0)](https://github.com/aiscihub/cookieguard-ai/blob/main/docs/CI_GUIDE.md#quick-start-playwright): `startCookieAudit(context, { origins, policy })` then `assertCookiePolicy(await audit.evaluate())`.
- [CLI (npm: cookieguard-ci 0.2.0)](https://github.com/aiscihub/cookieguard-ai/blob/main/docs/CI_GUIDE.md#quick-start-cli): `npx --yes cookieguard-ci@0.2.0 scan URL --auth-cookie NAME --format json`.
- [GitHub Action](https://github.com/aiscihub/cookieguard-ai/blob/main/action/README.md): `aiscihub/cookieguard-ai/action@ci-v0.1.0`.
- [MCP server (npm: @aiscihub/cookieguard-mcp 0.2.0; MCP Registry: io.github.aiscihub/cookieguard)](https://github.com/aiscihub/cookieguard-ai/tree/main/packages/mcp): local stdio server with a startup allowlist and policy; tools `cookieguard_capabilities`, `cookieguard_audit`, and `cookieguard_explain`.

## For agents

- [Agent Skill (SKILL.md)](https://github.com/aiscihub/cookieguard-ai/blob/main/skills/cookieguard-browser-auth-security/SKILL.md): when to use CookieGuard, which integration to pick, and how to read results.
- [Capability document (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aiscihub/cookieguard-ai/main/cookieguard.capabilities.json): every check, operation, input, output schema, exit code, privacy property, and limitation.
- [Output JSON Schemas](https://github.com/aiscihub/cookieguard-ai/tree/main/schemas): report, MCP audit result, explanation, CLI error, and capabilities.
- [Rules CG001-CG009](https://github.com/aiscihub/cookieguard-ai/blob/main/skills/cookieguard-browser-auth-security/references/security-checks.md)
